escalation.suspected_cause: Third-party payments provider is under scheduled maintenance (ETA unknown); it refuses all charges with 503.
escalation.evidence: Payments log: "charge refused: provider-side scheduled maintenance in progress" (POST /charge 503). Shop log: payment rejected (HTTP 503): {"error":"provider_maintenance","message":"Payments provider is under maintenance. ETA unknown."}. Smoke: checkout fails with 502 upstream_status 503; the other 4 checks pass (health, catalog, latency, stats_integrity). Both shop and payments processes are running.
escalation.actions_taken: Read-only diagnosis only (smoke tests, service status, logs). No changes made, because the connector process is healthy and a restart can't fix a provider outage.
escalation.recommended_next_step: Contact the payments vendor or check their status page for the maintenance window. Re-run run_smoke_tests when it ends. Consider a maintenance banner on checkout until then. No shop-side change is needed.
